title: ComfyUI Batch Studio Workflow Template Manifest
description: Standard ComfyUI generation template binding, schemaVersion 2. Legacy node roles are unsupported.
$comment: A manifest declares exactly one base-loader topology: Illustrious checkpoint or Anima diffusionModel/textEncoder/vae. Batch Studio semantic validation additionally verifies template.sha256 against exact UTF-8 template bytes; common role nodes exist outside branchPrototype.nodeIds; branch role nodes belong to branchPrototype.nodeIds; every crossing Common-to-Branch link is declared exactly once; internal prototype links are cloned automatically; role aliases may point to the same node.
